account_settings_screen__title.description: Displays the title 'Account Settings' in the navigation bar.

account_settings_screen__settings_option.name: account_settings_screen__settings_options_list
account_settings_screen__settings_option.description: A list of settings options including Email, Password, Country of residence, Login security, and Connected Accounts & Contacts.
